purpose: Retrospective evidence review of every protocol in the authenticated 67-document campaign inventory. This neither authorizes a new experiment nor changes a historical gate.

groups.name: Confirmation
groups.finding: Public-candidate acquisition and exact-sequence overlap checks were completed without treating renamed identifiers or nonmatching remainders as independent validation. The retained review records 8846 CGOB records matching exposed inputs and 305131 ParaBench records matching corrected QfO. The four legacy bacterial archive endpoints returned 404; this bounded search is not proof that all archives are absent.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: No independently eligible new confirmation panel or promoted method exists. Reference-assignment scoring, ancestral-target admission and prospective simulation confirmation are not claimed; missing confirmation remains a nonblocking limitation.

groups.name: Adaptive Coverage
groups.finding: The nominal denominator overstated observed probe coverage. The current engine uses the actual probe count and handles an empty query set. Historical arithmetic is retained as an explicitly counterfactual formula, not falsely reproduced by the corrected engine. Original diagnostic/helper bytes are bound in Git at bdc9ff5b; original failed tests and subsequent scoped corrections are preserved.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Fixed-cap biological controls bypass adaptive selection. No new accuracy vector or biological improvement is inferred from this arithmetic repair.

groups.name: Boundary Kernel
groups.finding: Isolated opt-in builds preserve exact integer scores, broader complete search outputs and all 62377 compared full-pipeline artifacts in the tested OrthoBench pair. Multiple warmed batch shapes showed directional cost gains. One sequential shared-host full-pipeline pair is not an isolated or counterbalanced speed experiment.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Broader dataset confirmation and reproducible controlled cost evidence would be required for default compile-flag promotion. No live benchmark library or default flag was replaced.

groups.name: Regression Audit
groups.finding: All 90 campaign-changed test modules and nine distinct production-neighbor modules executed in the frozen follow-up. Four initial failures and two skips were preserved; the scoped diagnostic/portable-path corrections retained the full selection. Both retained-science integration fixtures executed. Production files and original CPU libraries remain unchanged from the scientific revision under test.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: This is the selected 99-file campaign regression, not every repository test or biological validation. Original-scope completion is assessed separately, not inferred from green tests.

groups.name: Canonical Ordering
groups.finding: Independent winner arithmetic reproduces arrival sensitivity. The QfO matched-graph probe holds the RBNH graph and seed-4 partition fixed and reproduces both original multipass partitions through two changed exact-tie choices. Complete downstream endpoint vectors and separate scoring recovery exist. Canonical ordering changes memberships, not only serialization; later changes cannot all be uniquely attributed to the initiating tie.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Canonical is an opt-in reproducible experimental control. Passing the point screen does not establish neutrality, broad accuracy improvement or default eligibility.

groups.name: Cap Recovery
groups.finding: The original fresh-control crash, failed fresh cap400 clustering, cached final-graph recovery, completed native stage with a scoring-import failure and successful scoring-only recovery remain separately represented. The admitted recovered control and candidate retain the complete QfO universe and original inference settings; the cap400 vector loses all four tracked primary F1 endpoints. Native and GO/EC overlap diagnostics separate changed prediction populations from annotation scores on shared relations.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: No reconstructed sum is uninterrupted fresh timing. The original scoring-only recovery plan was superseded when native failure was established; the later specific native, graph and export repairs supply the admitted evidence. No repeated successful initial search or automatic promotion is required.

groups.name: Component Context
groups.finding: Independent component reconstruction and terminal native/scoring admission recover the bounded 500-gene strong-component intervention, including failed attempts. It is inactive on the two narrow panels. GO loss is a changed eligible-pair population with unchanged shared serialized scores; a high/medium-label filter is not justified by the measured strata. Structural and corrected gene-LCA diagnostics cover all watched relations, with explicit bypass/cross-family handling.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: The component vector fails the original development screen. Fresh whole-pipeline advancement, larger bounds, annotation-based filtering and a new support-only accuracy rule are not justified or claimed.

groups.name: Copy Branches
groups.finding: Complete executed structural sidecars and exact reference-cohort joins distinguish large and medium copy regimes. The fixed threshold and deferral bound were not retuned. Large-only inactivity on 12-species panels is recorded as exact reuse, not a new accuracy success. Every active noncontrol full vector fails the original screen.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: A live structural snapshot was not treated as terminal score admission. The later complete branch admission supplies score evidence.

groups.name: Deferred Families
groups.finding: Fixed-tree diagnostic and candidate-specific inferred-tree evaluations remain distinct. Exact native/control, raw-tree reuse and source gates were enforced; the mismatched historical OrthoBench control and overlong Darwin namespace failures were preserved before specific recovery. Paired tables and baseline graph context were independently recounted. Reference recall gains coexist with precision/GO/OrthoBench tradeoffs; the full inferred vector fails the screen.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: No increase of the 500-gene bound or selected-family exclusion. The fixed-tree six-endpoint diagnostic does not substitute for the eight-endpoint own-inferred result.

groups.name: Gene Support
groups.finding: Bipartition-based support restoration corrects measured transport errors while preserving the sample's topology, branch lengths, pairs, confidence labels and root groups. CLI/config/checkpoint propagation and edge cases have focused tests and are included in the consolidated regression.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Legacy remains the default. The same exposed 32-family sample and mocked full-stage integration are not full real-dataset equivalence or an accuracy mechanism. A new support-aware inference rule was not established by the subsequent gene-LCA diagnostics.

groups.name: Held Tree
groups.finding: Both supplied-own-tree and supplied-baseline-tree arms completed native and six-endpoint independent readback on the same broader candidates. The own-tree control reproduces the deterministic broader-direct scores. Tree substitution leaves VGNC unchanged, slightly increases SwissTrees and slightly decreases TreeFam; it does not resolve the broader-candidate regression.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: This is conditional whole-tree substitution including rooting/branch context, not proof of a unique topology cause or a transferable anchor-tree method. FAS is unseeded; these two diagnostic arms are preserved separately from the 28 primary table configurations.

groups.name: Matched K4 Cost
groups.finding: Six label-free query/complete-target comparisons use actual high_sensitivity k4 and independently reproduce outputs. They prioritize HMM scoring/candidate efficiency over already-vectorized profile construction.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: The earlier k3 micro sample remains valid only for its stated settings. Neither sample extrapolates full-pipeline speed, future runtimes or accuracy.

groups.name: Protected Union
groups.finding: All 144 cached/fresh direction equivalence checks precede the complete-proteome OrthoBench pilot. Native/scoring admission confirms actual CPU HMM/profile routes, fresh trees and complete ownership. The strict positive-F1 and P/R pilot gate fails. Paired 70-family uncertainty and its exact-seed repeat do not overturn that decision. Candidate-versus-final localization shows the deficit before reconciliation; species-tree topology is unchanged.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: The failed strict gate explicitly forbids unchanged-policy QfO/Three Kingdoms extension and retuning. Seven NA endpoints are the stopping rule, not unfinished authorized inference. Adjusted intervals crossing zero do not prove equivalence or inferiority.

groups.name: QfO Localization
groups.finding: Native aliases, reference eligibility and full-universe stages were audited before the bounded copy-family experiments. In this exposed VGNC cohort, 3180 of 4272 cross-species false negatives separate at profile refinement, frequently despite native graph support. Within-species assertions and native pair labels are retained.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Stage association is not proof that every separated family should be restored or that broader graph merging improves biological accuracy. The subsequent negative complete-vector experiments constrain that hypothesis.

groups.name: Recent Uncertainty
groups.finding: Recent OrthoBench candidates retain paired-family point estimates, seeded resampling, nominal intervals and the prespecified six-endpoint Bonferroni-tail adjustment. Complete matched family sufficient statistics and low-certainty inputs are required, not aggregate-F1 equality alone.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: No independently unexposed validation, universal confidence statement or VGNC/GO/EC uncertainty was invented. Passing a 0.005 point screen is not statistical equivalence.

groups.name: Membership
groups.finding: The original four-arm factorial and matching Three Kingdoms supplement are closed. Golden direct controls, complete gene ownership, immutable checkpoints and compatible tree reuse are checked by the retained admission code. Original unavailable cells remain alongside recovered results. Path support never turns transitive connectivity into additional native ortholog pairs.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Control_path passes only the development screen; broader candidates regress QfO. No cached replay is described as recovery of initially absent HMM hits or as isolated fresh timing.

groups.name: Search Sensitivity
groups.finding: All six prespecified fresh HMM search arms and both significance thresholds are retained, with complete target backgrounds, every scored candidate/value and exact control checks. Cap400 gains watched accepted links without losing control links; other shortlist/alphabet/k variants lose links and were not forced into expensive trials. The later whole-pipeline cap400 result is negative, so watched-link recovery is not presented as accuracy gain.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: Reference labels select only the exposed diagnostic query/cohort, not inference candidates. Micro-stage counts/costs are not full-dataset accuracy, large claimed speedups or a basis for profile caching without measured need.

groups.name: Shared Hit
groups.finding: Fresh full searches and inferred trees are compared with authenticated canonical controls. Failed and skipped QfO attempts are retained. Derived export removes exactly one identical redundant row while preserving all 5561114 distinct native relations/confidence values, then all six scores are independently admitted. GO/EC overlap and native turnover diagnostics preserve annotation scores on shared pairs and expose population effects.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: The original duplicate's cause is unknown; no producer bug fix or uninterrupted success is claimed. The complete vector fails the screen and no threshold retuning or default promotion follows.

groups.name: Singleton Ties
groups.finding: Both graph attachment stages use the same explicit singleton policy. Native first_hit controls reproduce canonical candidate/constraint and biological products before variants are interpreted. The OrthoBench decline 0.004471105890636373 passes the pre-existing follow-up tolerance, allowing unchanged-setting QfO/Three Kingdoms completion with split frozen driver/scientific manifests.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: The full vector's narrow point-screen pass is mixed development evidence, not equivalence, a default change or independent confirmation. No tie threshold/reference-family retuning occurred.

groups.name: Center Recurrence
groups.finding: Private exact-score integer recurrence preserves arithmetic and input arrays on the prescribed cases, but all six paired median wall/CPU ratios exceed one. The computational candidate was rejected for advancement.
groups.conditional_not_triggered: No claim of universal slowdown, biological improvement, live-library replacement or default change. Its k3 evidence is not retroactively relabeled a live-k4 benchmark.

review_scope: Every inventory document belongs to exactly one review group. The protocol text, checks, independent readbacks and conditional dispositions must be reconciled before a final completion claim. Source/status assertions alone do not prove raw-data correctness; existing explicit native/control/admission validators, test evidence and provenance limits remain part of the final requirement audit.
